summary: Scalar deleting destructor pattern: unconditionally runs the real destructor DestructorWithMultipleConditionalFrees(this), then, when the low bit of the deleting-destructor flag a2 is set, releases the object itself through FreeWrapper_7bcf(this). Returns this unchanged in both paths.

local_names.this: object whose destructor chain runs; this object itself when the flag's bit 0 is set
local_names.a2: deleting-destructor flag byte; bit 0 controls whether the object storage is freed

operations.description: Unconditionally invoke the real destructor DestructorWithMultipleConditionalFrees on this before any deallocation decision
Only free the object when the bit-0 flag of the deleting-destructor flag a2 is set
When the guard passes, release the object storage by calling FreeWrapper_7bcf(this)
Return this, the object pointer, unchanged

unresolved: a2 is the standard deleting-destructor flag (bit 0 = free storage), but the packet does not identify which callers produce a2=0 (placement destruction) versus a2=1
The object type owned by this destructor and the members freed inside DestructorWithMultipleConditionalFrees are not established by the packet
